findings.obs_text: In Jos 1:8 and Psa 1:2 the meditating (H1897) is qualified by time: day, with night beside it, says when it goes on, without a break.
In Jos 1:8 the negator (H3808) reaches the departing of the book from the mouth, not the meditating, and the adverbs then (H0227A) reach the prospering and the success that follow the doing.
findings.grounds: shall not depart from your mouth

findings.obs_text: In Pro 15:28 righteous (H6662) qualifies the heart that ponders, and evil things (H7451H) is the object of the other side, the mouth of the wicked: the pondering heart is set against the pouring mouth.
findings.grounds: The heart of the righteous ponders

findings.obs_text: In Psa 119:23 and Psa 119:78 the meditating is set against opponents by the clause before it: even (H1571) makes the plotting of princes a concession, and the insolent (H2086) are the ones who wrong the speaker.
findings.grounds: your servant will meditate on your statutes

findings.obs_text: In 1Ki 18:27 the musing (H7879) is one of the states Elijah lists in mockery, beside a journey and sleep; perhaps (H0194) and asleep (H3463) reach the last of them, and aloud (H1419A) reaches the crying.
In Pro 5:21, Luk 2:19 and Act 10:19 the qualifiers reach other words: before (H5227) the ways set before the eyes of the Lord, all (G3956) the things Mary treasured, three (G5140) the men who come.

older.reason: it states the face of ponders in Pro 15:28: the righteous heart pondering, against the mouth that pours out; a statement of the verse

older.finding: aloud gives audibility: the inner state named by another word of the verse is voiced so that it is heard
older.reason: it states how an inner state is voiced; the aloud words are of the roar collection

older.finding: righteous as godliness, devoutness or uprightness of a person, a state of the heart toward God or toward what is right
older.reason: it states a face of the righteous words; the righteous collection owns it
